translation.name: Yoac kekehagocac Dzadzahac gboria nga Mitiyegec

content: Merikisede ye Sareng taonggac ngictau amma Anutu engenatoa yeac womong gareng kefec. Nga Abarahang ye ngictau yenigoc ewema kpebucyunuecfunac dzigenema hamanu yeng sinnu ye meficgema keneheec.

Keneheu Abarahangngo iwaiya sasawa dzikacfunac meecmoc, ihacnac tennunac mocgu hendzicma Merikisede miec. Nga Merikisede yeac kpara titiha imoc, “Dindingac kekecac ngictau.” amma monggoc “Sarenggac ngictau.” imocac titiha “Ruaeac ngictau.”

Amma ye nonggomama nga esangabofora yeneac kpacarengngina mong mi oho ohoya. Nga ye fingec fingecnasoya kpac amma homec nasoya ifingoc kpac, ye Anutuac Medac siric isocngoc amma womong gareng nasosoc kecengkefude.
Anu dzite hania bangecnina Abarahangngo wiara dzikacfunac meec, imoc hendzicma teng imohacnac mocgu miec. Imocac ngeni hentegecbisia Merikisede ye ngic engenatoa.

Nga Rewiac bangecfora yeneng womong gareng ua mekecgecdeac uayoac megec, yeni ngicngac yenearunac tennunac mocgu imoc mekpedzuc ambisia, dedeseringo ifi dede. Nga ngicngac imoc yeni Abarahanggac bangecfora nga sactosofocngina kecma sifu yenearunac tennunac mocgu mekecgec.
Anu Merikisede ye yeneac arenunac mi fingerec, kpac. Amma ye sifu Abarahanggarunac tennunac mocgu mema ngic Anutuac dzadzahac mekefec, yenoc keneheec.
Nga ngic merang kenec miec, yeac kpacngo kenec meec, yeac ferahede. Mongngo yoac imoc naric mi kpeude.
Anu mong yofi, womong gareng homec bageau kecdae, yeneng tennunac mocgu kpedzucnema mekecdae. Nga Abrahangngo tennunac mocgu Merikisede miu meec, yeng ine kecdengoc, dedekperagi ifi nemmegec.
Amma yoac yofi naric denide, Rewi ye tennunac mocgu memeac ngic nga Merikisedengo Abarahanggarunac tennunac mocgu bic meec, imoc Rewiarunac meecac amma Rewi yengenaoc tennunac mocgu ifingoc faiec.
Merikisedengo Abarahanggoc sinnu ewaroc, naso imohai Rewi ye bangehaac hereu bic tarecac amma Abarahangngo Merikisede wiac miec, imoc Rewingo ifingoc miec ande.

Nga Isirae ngicngac yeneng dedeseriyoac megec, imohai yofi feec, Rewiac areng yeni womong gareng ua mebisia. Nga yeneng womong gareng ua megec wiac hafoangoc ngereebac dede Anutungo womong gareng monggoc fingerudeac mong mi debac. Nga yofi fingecbeso, womong gareng ngic mong Merikisede yeng kefec, siriha ifia fingecbeso amma ye Aronggac arennunac fingecbac imocngo mi ngereebac.
Nga womong garenggac ua areng gboria fingerudeu dedeseriyoacac areng gboria ifingoc fingecbeso, sing mong mi fede.
Amma womong gareng imoc ine kisic mong yenearunac nga yeac kisicfunac mongngo arata henggareng mong mi angkefec.
Kebuninango Yuda kisic yenearunac fingerec, imoc negendimbe. Nga Yudaac areng, yenearunac mongngo womong gareng anude, imocac Mosengo mong mi deec, kpac.
Anu Kebuninango Yuda kisicfunac fingecma Merikisedengo womong gareng kefec, ifi isoc womong gareng anec, imocngo monggoc dekperagiu Rewi arenggac womonggareng ua soha mi anec.
Womong garengtoa ye sac areng mocguac manau modacma fingecbeso, dedeseringo imoc dede. Nga Kebunina ine kekec dzonggo dzonggoa kpac imocac kucfu womong garengtoa anec.
Yeac negemma dedekperagi yoac yofi fede,

content.text: “Geng Merikisedeac siricfu womonggareng wisic wisickea kpac kecengkecnade.” (Mitiyegec 110:4)

content: Dedeseriyoac kucmama nga memefiha kpac warac hau yoac imocngo faka warac feec, imoc meickeu kpac andarec.

Dedeseriyoacngo memengerec ua hafoa mong mi meec, kpac. Nga Anutungo yofinenggac sing mong mesarinemmeec, imocngo warac sing feec, imoc ferahede. Nga nenang sing imoc modacma Anutuac hoannu kengkecnide.
Anutungo yoara meserima Yesungo womonggareng anudeac deseriec.
Womong gareng Rewiac arennunac yeneac demeseriyoac ifia mong mi feec. Ye imoc Yesuaru faima yofi edeec,

content.text: “Kebungo yoara meserima yofi deec, ‘Ge womong gareng wisic wisickea kpac kecengkecnade.’ ye yoara ifi meserima naric mi waude.”

content: Anutungo Yesuac ifi meseriec, imocac amma Yesungo dzadzahac gboria imocac nonggo tarec. Ifi taru dzadzahac gboriango eseaac kuc feraheude.

Womong gareng Rewiac arennunac yeni ngic homac. Nga homebesandaengo ua imoc mekecgecdeac homecngo womonggareng ua imocac kpae anec. Imocac amma mong homeu mongngo torokpeu torokpe meerekecma womong gareng ua megec amma yaguc meandae.
Nga Yesungo ine wisic wisickea kpac kecengkefude, imocac womong gareng ua yegoc wisic wisickea kpac amma feeng kecbesande.
Ye nasosoc Anutuac kicfu yoacfu meficnunuudeac kefudeac ngicngac yearusing Anutuaru kennide, nenang hafoangoc mengerenunuudeac mi obohoude.

Anu womong garengtoa yennoc naric meficnunuude. Ye kpetiac nga kopocsiha kpac, kongaha amma wononga kpac. Anutungo ye ngic kopocsicmeme yeneac botucfunac meickeu ye kurumeng sasawa fekende, imoc feracyunuma wi kecde.

Nga womong garengtoa Rewiac arennu yeni wenacsoc yenang kopocsicac sese faimaguc ngicngac yeneac kopocsicac ngade faikecdae. Nga Yesungo faka imocac bageau mi kefec, kpac. Ye ine sese dema yengena faiemeec nga yeng imoc naso mocgusac meu soha anec.

Foracngoc, dedeseringo ngic kucmamagoc uayoac deyemmeu womong garengtoa angkecdae. Nga demeseriyoacgoc fingerec, imocngo Medac uayoac demiu yeng tatac mema kucmamea kpac nga hafoangoc gombunga wisic wisickea kpac feengkefude.
